text: On the full city the map opens and paints within a second, even right after load, framed on the player and every Founder Trail stop, and building the city map never freezes the game.
The map numbers every Founder Trail stop and highlights the current objective; side activities appear on the map, minimap and compass only when Show side activities is on.
The map's objective bar and every trail stop card have a Warp button that emits the warp event with the stop's local position and name.
The minimap points a line and an edge arrow at the current objective.
